entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press one.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, Alex. I need to return a helmet I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, the order number is VF558021.

Thank you. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the Urban Commuter Helmet, purchased 64 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I expected when it arrived. I never even took it out of the packaging, so the box is unopened.
I understand. Let me just double-check our return policy for you... Yes, I see here that you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

That's great news, thank you. I do have one small question. Since I'm returning it in perfect condition and the box is unopened, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for a future purchase? I'd like to order a different helmet, as your safety ratings are excellent.

I appreciate you asking and for keeping the helmet in its original condition. While I can't provide a discount code on top of the full refund, I can assure you that you will receive the full purchase price back once we receive the item. I'm generating the prepaid return shipping label for you now.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund is what I was hoping for. Please send the label over.
The label has just been sent to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with any carrier. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
